{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute the number of patients with severe baseline disease
num_severe = len(df_dedup[df_dedup['severity'] == 'severe'])
print('Number of patients with severe baseline disease:', num_severe)

# Compute total number of unique patients
num_total = len(df_dedup)
print('Total number of unique patients:', num_total)

# Compute fraction
fraction_severe = num_severe / num_total
print('Fraction of patients with severe baseline disease:', fraction_severe)"}
